physics_boundary.core_statement: A submerged structure does not need to emit sound spontaneously. It can selectively scatter, ring and transform an incident broadband acoustic field. The measurable object is its transfer function, target-strength spectrum and impulse response.
not_assumed: ancient pyramids were designed as acoustic transmitters
119 Hz is a universal physical pyramid frequency
a single spectral peak proves pyramidal geometry
a bathymetric shape inferred from satellite gravity is a physical structure

medium_model.reason: sound speed in seawater varies with temperature, salinity and pressure/depth

state_branches.prediction: fluid acoustic modes tend to scale approximately with local sound speed for unchanged rigid geometry; openings and losses modify Q and mode positions
internal air modes can remain near dry-cavity values while structural modes and exterior radiation change through water added mass and damping
hybrid air-water free-surface and structural modes; fluid level becomes an additional state variable and may create a distinctive multi-mode signature
cavity ringing may be weak or inaccessible; search shifts toward elastic/scattering resonances and sub-bottom/seismic impedance contrasts

objects: scaled hollow square pyramid matching chosen geometry

excitation.preferred: calibrated underwater acoustic projector with logarithmic or broadband chirp
excitation.level_rule: minimum level required for repeatable SNR; comply with tank and field environmental and equipment limits

scale_invariant_fingerprint.reason: unknown target scale moves absolute frequencies; ratios and normalized frequencies are more transferable than a single 119 or 520 Hz peak

required: same spectral or mode pattern on at least 3 independent passes
multi-aspect geometry consistent with one stationary target
better template score than natural and geologic controls

love_edem_exact_point_binding.bisector_calibration_rule: Acoustic localization may measure the residual between a detected target and the frozen bisector prediction. It must never recenter the bisector after seeing the target.
love_edem_exact_point_binding.next_real_measurement: direct low-frequency sub-bottom or seismic or dedicated acoustic survey through the frozen coordinate
